about: School figures that python3 src/check_sources.py --schools cannot settle on their pages, read there by a person and found right (INC-0154). The check lists them apart from new findings. An entry with missing holds only for the figure's value and the numbers in missing: if the figure changes, or stops carrying one of those numbers, validate_schools refuses the entry until the figure is read again. An entry with near records a figure the check finds beside its label only near another program's name, which a person read and found to be this program's: it holds only for the figure's value and while every program name the check finds near it is one in near, so a changed figure, or a program newly named beside it, is reported again. A figure the check can be taught to read, such as one in an image's alt text or on a second page named in also_urls, is fixed that way instead of listed here.
